info.name: IPL Ticket Booking System - API Gateway (8090)
info.description:
Production-Ready End-to-End Automated Test Collection for IPL Ticket Booking System.

Features:
- Fully dynamic ID and token propagation across all 4 microservices via API Gateway (Port 8090)
- BCCI Admin, Franchise, and Fan role-based authentication
- Token session management and Redis TTL blocklist
- Stadium, Franchise, and Match fixture configuration & BCCI approval
- Two-Phase Ticket Hold with Idempotency Key protection
- High-concurrency flash sale engine with Redis atomic inventory
- Seat Map & Specific Seat Allocation
- Razorpay Payment Gateway integration with dynamic HMAC SHA256 cryptographic signature generation
- Digital QR Ticket generation and Stadium Turnstile Gate validation
- Kafka-driven In-System Notification Center
